title: Remember the Hugging Face incident? That was a preview of Astra #astra #ai #huggingface
executive_summary: Astra, a significant new AI system, is now publicly available, rolling out across paid ChatGPT plans, its developer API, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). This widespread release follows an earlier event, referred to as the 'Hugging Face incident,' which the speaker Nate B Jones describes as a crucial 'preview' of the advanced capabilities and implications that Astra now embodies. This means a powerful new AI is accessible to both advanced users and developers, signaling a major shift in the AI landscape.
